title: The Signal Dives
description: The pulse train does not end at the decoded line. It
dives, on and down, into a shaft the city never dug
and the machine never admits to, and at the bottom of
it the signal goes to paper.
The archive is next: shelves below shelves, a library
at the bottom of the world, kept by a librarian who
has been filing the signal since before the stairs
Six stations, the same six, in lamp-lit ink.
Leave the wire running. A signal is a promise kept on
a schedule; ending one is a decision that belongs to
